answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 9093 Country: India Title: Assalamu alaikum when doing wazu we have to wash our legs compulsarily or not? In my office it is difficult for me to wash my legs for wazu.i cant remove my shoes in toilet so i am asking this question.With out washing my legs can i Perform namaz? Kya wazu me pair dhone ke baghair namz padshkte ya nehe? Question: Assalamu alaikum when doing wazu we have to wash our legs compulsarily or not? In my office it is difficult for me to wash my legs for wazu.i cant remove my shoes in toilet so i am asking this question.With out washing my legs can i Perform namaz? Kya wazu me pair dhone ke baghair namz padshkte ya nehe? Answer ID: 9093 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2055/1887=D/1429) It is fardh (compulsory) to wash feet in wudhu ; the wudhu shall not be valid without it, so the salah also will not be valid. You should wash the feet and then pray salah. Have a slipper for the same and make wudhu wearing it and later wear the shoes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
